newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch gold reserves down Dfl 69 mln by Feb 17.
newsitem.headline: Dutch gold reserves down Dfl 69 mln by Feb 17.

text.p: Dutch official gold reserves fell by 69 million guilders to a book value of 14.96 billion in the week to February 17, central bank data showed.
The Dutch central bank said on January 13 it had sold 300 tonnes of bullion in 1996 and that the transactions as forward sales would not show up in official statistics until February.

As the finance ministry holds gold at a book value of 13,900 guilders per kilo, the figures indicate that last week 4,964 kilos of gold were settled as part of that sale. --Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
